Then the step retries on the workflow schedule, nothing moves, and a repeated submission writes once and answers once

  Scenario: AC8 Consumed call fails or does not answer (NEWAC-RWB-S5-E4028-APP-AC8)
    Given the rwb-integration contract mock returns a failed answer to the SCIS transfer of vehicle asset "AST-2026-000541"
    When its trigger arrives
    Then nothing moves, the case stays in TITLE_TRANSFER_PENDING, and no answer reaches rwb-case

  Scenario: AC9 Disallowed status change is refused (NEWAC-RWB-S5-E4028-APP-AC9)
    Given the case of the vehicle asset is in a state other than TITLE_TRANSFER_PENDING
    When a move of the case to ASSET_SOLD is requested
    Then the move is refused, nothing changes and no answer is sent to rwb-case
